Grammar: Reduplication of monosyllabic verbs (A -> AA or A一A, e.g. 说说/说一说, 听听/听一听, 看看/看一看)
Grammar: Reduplication of disyllabic verbs (AB -> ABAB, e.g. 学习学习, 准备准备, 运动运动)
Grammar: Intonation of a declarative sentence (usually falling intonation)
Grammar: Negative of complement of result (没(有) + V + complement; 了 cannot end the sentence)
Grammar: Question with complement of result (add (了)没有 at the end of the sentence)
Grammar: Intonation of a yes-no question (predicate stressed, rising intonation at the end)
Grammar: Intonation of a specific question (interrogative pronoun stressed, intonation then falls gradually)
欢 (huān) - merry, happy
对 (duì) - right, correct
帮 (bāng) - to help, to aid
帽 (mào) - hat, cap
块 (kuài) - lump, piece
地 (dì) - earth, land, ground
热 (rè) - hot
黑 (hēi) - black
超 (chāo) - to exceed, to surpass
起 (qǐ) - to get up, to rise
空 (kōng) - empty
穿 (chuān) - to pierce through, to penetrate
服务员，我房间的门打不开了。 (Fúwùyuán, wǒ fángjiān de mén dǎ bu kāi le.) - Excuse me, I can't open my door.
您住哪个房间？ (Nín zhù nǎge fángjiān?) - Which room do you stay in?
317。 (Sān yāo qī.) - Room 317.
好的，我叫人去看看。 (Hǎo de, wǒ jiào rén qù kànkan.) - OK. I'll send someone to have a check.
你看看这几件衣服怎么样。 (Nǐ kànkan zhè jǐ jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.) - What do you think of these dresses?
这件白的有点儿长。 (Zhè jiàn bái de yǒudiǎnr cháng.) - This white one is a little bit too long.
那件黑的有点儿贵。 (Nà jiàn hēi de yǒudiǎnr guì.) - That black one is a bit expensive.
这件红的呢？ (Zhè jiàn hóng de ne?) - What about this red one?
这是今天新来的。 (Zhè shì jīntiān xīn lái de.) - This one has just got here today.
让我再看看。 (Ràng wǒ zài kànkan.) - Let me look again (I'll look around).
我们一起去吃饭，好吗？ (Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chī fàn, hǎo ma?) - Shall we go to eat together?
你明天下午给我打电话，好吗？ (Nǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà, hǎo ma?) - Will you call me tomorrow afternoon?
我们下午去看电影，好吗？ (Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?) - Shall we go to see a movie in the afternoon?
你再看看这本书吧。 (Nǐ zài kànkan zhè běn shū ba.) - Take another look at this book.
你（明天）再给我打电话吧。 (Nǐ (míngtiān) zài gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà ba.) - Call me again (tomorrow).
让我想想再告诉你。 (Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.) - Let me think about it and then I'll tell you.
我请你吃饭。 (Wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn.) - I invite you to a meal.
你让我再想想。 (Nǐ ràng wǒ zài xiǎngxiang.) - You let me think again.
我叫人去看看。 (Wǒ jiào rén qù kànkan.) - I ask someone to go and have a look.
他们为什么今天下午不去看电影？ (Tāmen wèi shénme jīntiān xiàwǔ bú qù kàn diànyǐng?) - Why aren't they going to see a movie this afternoon?
王老师为什么让他给大卫打电话？ (Wáng lǎoshī wèi shénme ràng tā gěi Dàwèi dǎ diànhuà?) - Why did Teacher Wang ask him to call David?
大卫怎么了？ (Dàwèi zěnme le?) - What's wrong with David?
她为什么去找服务员？ (Tā wèi shénme qù zhǎo fúwùyuán?) - Why does she go to find the attendant?
她为什么不喜欢那件黑的？ (Tā wèi shénme bù xǐhuan nà jiàn hēi de?) - Why doesn't she like the black one?
妈妈，我们一起＿＿＿＿，好吗？ (Māma, wǒmen yìqǐ ＿＿＿＿ hǎo ma?) - Mom, shall we ____ together? (picture-description exercise)
再见，我明天再＿＿＿＿。 (Zàijiàn, wǒ míngtiān zài ＿＿＿＿.) - Goodbye, I will ____ again tomorrow. (picture-description exercise)
老师让我再＿＿＿＿。 (Lǎoshī ràng wǒ zài ＿＿＿＿.) - The teacher asks me to ____ again. (picture-description exercise)
老师叫同学们＿＿＿＿。 (Lǎoshī jiào tóngxuémen ＿＿＿＿.) - The teacher asks the students to ____. (picture-description exercise)
我学习汉语。 (Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ.) - I study Chinese.
他是我的老师。 (Tā shì wǒ de lǎoshī.) - He is my teacher.
外边天气很好。 (Wàibian tiānqì hěn hǎo.) - The weather outside is very good.
老师让我写汉字。 (Lǎoshī ràng wǒ xiě Hànzì.) - The teacher asks me to write Chinese characters.
你好！请问张欢在吗？ (Nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Zhāng Huān zài ma?) - Hello! May I speak to Zhang Huan?
你打错了，我们这儿没有叫张欢的。 (Nǐ dǎcuò le, wǒmen zhèr méiyǒu jiào Zhāng Huān de.) - You've got the wrong number. There isn't a person called Zhang Huan here.
对不起。 (Duìbuqǐ.) - I'm sorry.
您从几岁开始学习跳舞？ (Nín cóng jǐ suì kāishǐ xuéxí tiào wǔ?) - At what age did you start to learn dancing?
我第一次跳舞是在七岁的时候。 (Wǒ dì yī cì tiào wǔ shì zài qī suì de shíhou.) - I was seven when I danced for the first time.
我女儿今年也七岁了。 (Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián yě qī suì le.) - My daughter is seven now.
我希望她能跟您学跳舞，可以吗？ (Wǒ xīwàng tā néng gēn nín xué tiào wǔ, kěyǐ ma?) - I hope she can learn to dance from you, can she?
没问题，非常欢迎。 (Méi wèntí, fēicháng huānyíng.) - Sure. It's my pleasure.
你知道吗？大卫找到工作了。 (Nǐ zhīdào ma? Dàwèi zhǎodào gōngzuò le.) - You know what? David has got a job.
太好了！他从什么时候开始上班？ (Tài hǎo le! Tā cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàng bān?) - That's great! When will he start to work?
从下个星期一开始。 (Cóng xià ge xīngqī yī kāishǐ.) - Next Monday.
这是他的第一个工作，希望他能喜欢。 (Zhè shì tā de dì yī ge gōngzuò, xīwàng tā néng xǐhuan.) - This is his first job. I hope he will like it.
昨天的考试怎么样？你都听懂了吗？ (Zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng? Nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?) - How was the test yesterday? Did you understand everything you heard?
听懂了。 (Tīngdǒng le.) - Yes, I did (I understood).
你都做完了没有？ (Nǐ dōu zuòwán le méiyǒu?) - Did you finish the test paper?
题太多，我没做完。 (Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuòwán.) - There were too many questions, I didn't finish all of them.
我看见你的女朋友了。 (Wǒ kànjiàn nǐ de nǚpéngyou le.) - I saw your girlfriend.
我听懂今天的汉语课了。 (Wǒ tīngdǒng jīntiān de Hànyǔ kè le.) - I understood today's Chinese class.
我做好饭了。 (Wǒ zuòhǎo fàn le.) - I have finished cooking.
大卫找到工作了。 (Dàwèi zhǎodào gōngzuò le.) - David has found a job.
我没有看见你的女朋友。 (Wǒ méiyǒu kànjiàn nǐ de nǚpéngyou.) - I didn't see your girlfriend.
我没听懂他说的话。 (Wǒ méi tīngdǒng tā shuō de huà.) - I didn't understand what he said.
我没做完（考试题）。 (Wǒ méi zuòwán (kǎoshì tí).) - I haven't finished (the test questions).
你看见我的女朋友了没有？ (Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de nǚpéngyou le méiyǒu?) - Did you see my girlfriend?
你听懂他说的话没有？ (Nǐ tīngdǒng tā shuō de huà méiyǒu?) - Did you understand what he said?

从老人到孩子都喜欢吃苹果。 (Cóng lǎorén dào háizi dōu xǐhuan chī píngguǒ.) - From the old to the children, all like eating apples.
从下个星期一开始（上班）。 (Cóng xià ge xīngqī yī kāishǐ (shàng bān).) - Starting from next Monday (go to work).

你都听懂了吗？ (Nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?) - Did you understand everything?

今天上午你看见大卫了吗？ (Jīntiān shàngwǔ nǐ kànjiàn Dàwèi le ma?) - Did you see David this morning?
不要看电视了，明天上午还有汉语课呢。 (Búyào kàn diànshì le, míngtiān shàngwǔ hái yǒu Hànyǔ kè ne.) - Stop watching TV. You'll have a Chinese class tomorrow morning.

别看报纸了，医生说你要多休息。 (Bié kàn bàozhǐ le, yīshēng shuō nǐ yào duō xiūxi.) - Stop reading the newspaper. The doctor said you need more rest.
好，不看了。 (Hǎo, bú kàn le.) - OK. (I won't read any more.)
给我一杯茶吧。 (Gěi wǒ yì bēi chá ba.) - Give me a cup of tea.
医生说吃药后两个小时不要喝茶。 (Yīshēng shuō chī yào hòu liǎng ge xiǎoshí búyào hē chá.) - The doctor said you shouldn't drink tea during the first two hours after you've taken the medicine.
医生还说什么了？ (Yīshēng hái shuō shénme le?) - What else did the doctor say?
医生让你听我的。 (Yīshēng ràng nǐ tīng wǒ de.) - The doctor said you should listen to me.
你怎么买了这么多东西啊？ (Nǐ zěnme mǎile zhème duō dōngxi a?) - Why did you buy so many things?
哥哥今天中午回来吃饭。 (Gēge jīntiān zhōngwǔ huílai chī fàn.) - Our elder brother will come back to have lunch today.
我看看买什么了。 (Wǒ kànkan mǎi shénme le.) - Let me see what was bought.
羊肉、鸡蛋、面条、西瓜……真不少！ (Yángròu, jīdàn, miàntiáo, xīguā…… zhēn bù shǎo!) - Mutton, eggs, noodles, watermelon... That's a lot!
妈妈呢？ (Māma ne?) - Where is Mom?
正在准备午饭呢！ (Zhèngzài zhǔnbèi wǔfàn ne!) - She is preparing lunch!
你在找什么？ (Nǐ zài zhǎo shénme?) - What are you looking for?
你看见我的手机了吗？ (Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de shǒujī le ma?) - Have you seen my cell phone?
白色的。 (Báisè de.) - It's white.
别找了，手机在桌子上呢，电脑旁边。 (Bié zhǎo le, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shang ne, diànnǎo pángbiān.) - Stop looking for your cell phone. It's on the desk, beside the computer.
你看见我的衣服了吗？ (Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de yīfu le ma?) - Have you seen my garment?
红色的那件。 (Hóngsè de nà jiàn.) - The red one.
那件衣服我帮你洗了，在外边呢。 (Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ le, zài wàibian ne.) - I have washed it for you. It's hung outside.
不要玩手机了。 (Búyào wán shǒujī le.) - Stop playing with your cell phone.
不要做饭了。 (Búyào zuò fàn le.) - Stop cooking.
不要看电视了。 (Búyào kàn diànshì le.) - Stop watching TV.
别睡觉了。 (Bié shuìjiào le.) - Stop sleeping.
别看书了。 (Bié kàn shū le.) - Stop reading.
别看报纸了。 (Bié kàn bàozhǐ le.) - Stop reading the newspaper.
跑步对身体很好。 (Pǎobù duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) - Running is good for the body.
老师对学生非常好。 (Lǎoshī duì xuésheng fēicháng hǎo.) - The teacher is very good to the students.
看电视对学汉语有帮助。 (Kàn diànshì duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu bāngzhù.) - Watching TV is helpful for learning Chinese.
孩子们正在做什么？ (Háizimen zhèngzài zuò shénme?) - What are the children doing?
妈妈为什么不让他们看电视了？ (Māma wèi shénme bú ràng tāmen kàn diànshì le?) - Why doesn't Mom let them watch TV any more?
吃药以后可以喝茶吗？ (Chī yào yǐhòu kěyǐ hē chá ma?) - Can one drink tea after taking medicine?
